visual_description: A massive white plaster jacket containing a large dinosaur limb bone, secured to a rusted industrial steel pallet. The jacket is wrapped in yellow ratcheting straps and burlap webbing. Black stenciled text on the side reads 'MUSEUM OF PALEONTOLOGY - JACKET ID: TRX-07 - FRAGILE'. The scene is set in a spacious, concrete-floored warehouse with similar jackets in the blurred background.

constraints.logic: Represents the safe arrival of field specimens at the museum collections facility before laboratory preparation begins.
constraints.background: Industrial warehouse interior with high ceilings and cool, ambient lighting.
